construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written directly for this build.

shared_schema.lifecycle: input (null stages) -> researched (validated findings) -> ok (validated review)
shared_schema.request: Exact allowlisted hosts, requested URLs, synthetic response fixtures, one document, uniquely identified requirements with nonempty document_terms and evidence_terms.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validator checks all phases, strict keys/types, limits, uniqueness and URL policy. Offline deterministic replay validates complete stage structures and provenance; JSON canonicalization distinguishes booleans from integers.
shared_schema.errors: CLI emits one JSON error object and exits 2 for invalid input, JSON, encoding, usage or file errors.

cross_stage_handoffs: Research retrieves only requested fixture URLs, records redirect chains, source identities, original text and SHA-256 content digests.
Research findings carry requirement ID, source ID, final URL, digest, exact quote and zero-based character offsets.
Review executes only after research validation, links matching finding IDs and document offsets, and records missing terms by requirement with checked source IDs.
Final envelope is validated before output. Source retrieval failures remain traceable and produce evidence gaps rather than fabricated findings.

behavior.retrieval: Offline fixture map only, no networking. HTTPS exact-host allowlist also checked on redirects; credentials, fragments, backslashes and non-443 ports rejected. Five redirects maximum; loops, missing fixtures and HTTP failures are recorded.
behavior.matching: Deterministic case-sensitive literal substring matching. First occurrence per source/term. All required document and evidence terms must match; evidence can span requested sources.
behavior.provenance: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source/document text; quote offsets are Python Unicode character indices, not byte positions. Fixtures and complete request retained in final envelope.
behavior.interpretation: Textual support only. No certification, compliance approval or truth-verification claims.
behavior.synthetic_data: Example explicitly labeled SYNTHETIC and uses reserved .example domain.
behavior.additional_artifacts: docs\My_prompt.txt preserves the required prompt log; not a runtime deliverable.

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok
